# ShopMaster

> ShopMaster is an online shopping web application for discovering products, comparing available options, reading reviews, and shopping from sellers.

## Main entry point

- [ShopMaster homepage](https://testsampleindev.vercel.app/): the public storefront and entry point to the application.

## What the application offers

- Product discovery and category-based browsing.
- Product detail pages and customer reviews where available.
- Shopping cart and account-related features.
- Seller storefront and seller application experiences.
- Privacy and terms information accessible through the application navigation.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Treat product prices, stock, ratings, shipping information, and seller details as dynamic; verify them on the live page rather than inferring values.
- Do not claim a product is available or a transaction has completed unless the current application explicitly confirms it.
- The homepage is the canonical public URL. Hash-based application views are not separate standalone canonical pages.
- This file is descriptive guidance, not permission to bypass authentication or access private account, seller, or administrative data.
